opening.speaker: B
opening.text: Ten dollars says I can bounce a coin into that cup within three tries.

sample_args.claim: Jake bounces a coin into the cup on the table.
success_criteria: The coin bounces off the table at least once.
The coin ends up inside the cup.
failure_criteria: Throwing the coin directly into the cup without a bounce.

edge_cases.question: Three tries, first one in wins?
edge_cases.answer: Yes. Up to three tries; the first coin in the cup wins.
